# openwrt_qos_interface (Resource)

qos-scripts shaping for one interface (`config interface`).

Manages a `interface` section in `/etc/config/qos`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `classgroup` (String) Class group to use. (UCI option `classgroup`.)
- `download` (Number) Download rate in kbit/s. (UCI option `download`.)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable shaping. (UCI option `enabled`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `overhead` (Boolean) Account for protocol overhead. (UCI option `overhead`.)
- `upload` (Number) Upload rate in kbit/s. (UCI option `upload`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
